source: EAU-EANM-ESTRO-ESUR-ISUP-SIOG Guidelines on Prostate Cancer, Limited Update March 2026
description: Clinical thresholds extracted from EAU 2026 Guidelines for fact-checking guardrail. Covers T1 (biopsy decision), T2 (treatment decision), T3 (recurrence prediction).

thresholds.description: PSA threshold for considering prostate biopsy in early detection
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.1.1 / §5.4 (Gothenburg-2 study: PSA >= 3 ng/mL)

thresholds.description: PSA density threshold for biopsy indication; standard EAU threshold
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.4.2.b / §6.2.1.b.1 (DETECTIVE consensus: PSAD < 0.15 for AS eligibility)

thresholds.description: PSA density below 0.10 indicates low cancer detection rate for PI-RADS 3
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.2.4 (PSA-D below 0.10: 3% csPCa detection for PI-RADS 1-2)

thresholds.description: PSA density above 0.20 indicates high cancer detection rate for PI-RADS 3
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.2.4 (PSA-D above 0.20: 18% csPCa detection for PI-RADS 1-2)

thresholds.description: PI-RADS 4-5: biopsy recommended regardless of PSA density
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.5.8 Table (PI-RADS 4-5: Perform biopsy; detection 55-83%)

thresholds.description: PI-RADS 3: equivocal; biopsy decision depends on PSAD and risk factors
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.5.8 Table (PI-RADS 3: Consider biopsy; 20% csPCa detection)

thresholds.description: For PI-RADS 3 lesions, PSAD >= 0.15 is often used as threshold to proceed with biopsy
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.4.2.b / §5.2.4 (PSA-D stratifies PI-RADS 3 biopsy decision)

thresholds.description: PI-RADS 1-2: no biopsy recommended (6% csPCa detection)
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.5.8 Table (PI-RADS 1-2: No biopsy; 6% detection)

thresholds.description: PSA 3-10 ng/mL is the gray zone where biopsy decision depends on PSAD, PI-RADS, and other factors
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.1.1 / §5.4 (PSA gray zone 3-10 ng/mL)

thresholds.description: Screening may start at age 45 for men at elevated risk (BRCA mutations, family history)
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.1.3 / §5.1.4 (Screening in BRCA: biopsy if PSA > 3.0 ng/mL)

thresholds.description: PSA > 100 ng/mL with high suspicion of malignancy may avoid biopsy if comorbidities exclude treatment
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §5.1.3 (PSA > 100 ng/mL with positive bone scan)

thresholds.description: ISUP Grade Group 1 is the primary inclusion criterion for active surveillance
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.2.1.b.1 (AS inclusion: ISUP GG 1 on systematic biopsy)

thresholds.description: ISUP GG 2 may be eligible for AS in favourable intermediate-risk disease (PSA < 10, cT1-2)
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.2.1.b.2 (AS inclusion of intermediate risk: ISUP GG 2 + PSA < 10 + cT1-2)

thresholds.description: PSA < 10 ng/mL is required for active surveillance eligibility
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.2.1.b.1 (AS inclusion: PSA < 10 ng/mL)

thresholds.description: PSAD < 0.15 ng/mL/cc is standard AS inclusion criterion (though threshold remains controversial)
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.2.1.b.1 (AS inclusion: PSA-D < 0.15 ng/mL/cc, DETECTIVE consensus)

thresholds.description: Clinical stage cT1c or cT2a is required for AS eligibility
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.2.1.b.1 (AS inclusion: cT1c or cT2a)

thresholds.description: ISUP GG >= 2 (confirmed on pathology) may warrant active treatment, especially with high PSAD or PI-RADS 4-5
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.2.2 (ISUP >= 2 confirmed OR PI-RADS 4-5 with high PSAD)

thresholds.description: ISUP GG >= 3 (Gleason 4+3 or higher) indicates unfavourable intermediate or high risk; active treatment generally recommended
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 Table 4.3 (Unfavourable intermediate: ISUP GG 3; High risk: ISUP GG 4/5)

thresholds.description: EAU low risk: ISUP GG 1 AND PSA < 10 ng/mL AND cT1-2
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 Table 4.3 (Low risk group definition)

thresholds.threshold: ISUP GG2 + PSA < 10 + cT1-2 OR ISUP GG1 + PSA 10-20 + cT1-2
thresholds.description: EAU favourable intermediate risk: ISUP GG 2 + PSA < 10 + cT1-2, OR ISUP GG 1 + PSA 10-20 + cT1-2
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 Table 4.3 (Favourable intermediate risk group)

thresholds.threshold: ISUP GG2 + PSA 10-20 + cT1-2 OR ISUP GG3 + cT1-2
thresholds.description: EAU unfavourable intermediate risk: ISUP GG 2 + PSA 10-20 + cT1-2, OR ISUP GG 3 + cT1-2
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 Table 4.3 (Unfavourable intermediate risk group)

thresholds.threshold: ISUP GG 4/5 OR PSA > 20 OR cT3-4 and/or cN+
thresholds.description: EAU high risk: ISUP GG 4/5, OR PSA > 20 ng/mL, OR cT3-4 and/or cN+
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 Table 4.3 (High risk group definition)

thresholds.description: Clinical stage cT3 or higher defines high-risk disease regardless of ISUP grade or PSA
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 Table 4.3 (High risk: cT3-4 and/or cN+)

thresholds.description: PSA > 20 ng/mL defines high risk disease regardless of ISUP grade
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 Table 4.3 (High risk: PSA > 20 ng/mL)

thresholds.description: Watchful waiting is appropriate for patients with life expectancy < 10 years and low/intermediate risk disease
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.2.1.a / §6.1 (WW for limited life expectancy with comorbidities)

thresholds.description: ISUP GG > 2 on repeat biopsy is a trigger to escalate from active surveillance to active treatment
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.2.1.b.8 (AS change to active treatment triggers)

thresholds.description: BCR after radical prostatectomy: PSA > 0.2 ng/mL (commonly used threshold, confirmed on two consecutive measurements)
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.4.1 / §7.3.3.a (Post-RP recurrence: PSA > 0.2 ng/mL)

thresholds.description: PSA > 0.4 ng/mL after RP is the threshold that best predicts further metastases
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §7.3.5 (PSA > 0.4 ng/mL best predicts metastases after RP)

thresholds.description: BCR after radiotherapy: Phoenix definition = PSA nadir + 2 ng/mL
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.4.1 / §7.3.5 (Phoenix: nadir + 2 ng/mL after definitive RT)

thresholds.description: PSA persistence after RP: PSA nadir > 0.5 ng/mL after surgery (distinct from BCR which requires PSA rise after undetectable)
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.3.6.a (PSA persistence: nadir > 0.5 ng/mL after RP)

thresholds.description: Salvage radiotherapy is typically triggered when PSA > 0.2 ng/mL after RP (early salvage RT)
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §6.3.5.d (Early SRT at PSA > 0.2 ng/mL: RAVES, RADICALS-RT trials)

thresholds.description: event=0 means no biochemical recurrence by last follow-up (censored); PSA remained below threshold
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 §7.3 (Follow-up: censored = no BCR detected during follow-up period)

thresholds.description: ISUP Grade Group to Gleason score mapping: GG1=Gleason 2-6, GG2=Gleason 7(3+4), GG3=Gleason 7(4+3), GG4=Gleason 8, GG5=Gleason 9-10
thresholds.source: EAU 2026 Table 4.2 (ISUP 2014 grade group system)
